page.overview:
Who is African prince?

An African prince allegedly gifted Quirinus Quirrell with a turban as a token of his gratitude after the professor had rid him of a bothersome zombie. However, Quirrell's first-year Defence Against the Dark Arts students in the 1991–1992 school year were unsure if they believed his story or not.
